_comment: Generous starting budgets per Prompt 2 — the point right now is having the harness in place with a recorded baseline, not hitting a final target on a near-empty app. Tighten these as the app grows and re-baseline in later prompts as directed.

bundleSize._note: Near-empty app currently baselines around ~550KB (React + Next.js runtime chunks only). Budget set generously above that per Prompt 2's notes; tighten as real app code is added.

render3d._note: 33.3ms = 30fps floor. Prompt 2 benchmarks a trivial placeholder scene; Prompt 19 re-baselines against the real Game Room scene.
